tools.name: erp_get_production_plan
tools.description: Retrieve planned production runs by line and period (Line, Product, PlannedStart/End, PlannedQty), used as a demand-adjustment covariate for consumables tied to run-hours.

tools.name: erp_get_cost_center_budget
tools.description: Retrieve cost center budget and actual spend for a maintenance/MRO cost center and period, used for budget-fit checking of proposed procurement actions.

tools.name: erp_get_plant_calendar
tools.description: Retrieve plant calendar working days, shutdown windows, and holidays for a plant over a date range.

tools.name: erp_get_purchasing_info_record
tools.description: Retrieve the ERP-held purchasing info record (vendor/material pricing and lead time) for cross-checking against live Supplier Portal quotes and SAP MM vendor pricing.
